civil.title: Civil Engineering
civil.intro: Design, site supervision and technical advisory for reliable, lasting works in Benin and West Africa.
civil.overview: I support owners and project teams on design, control and site follow-up. My approach combines technical rigor, on-site presence and clear reporting — for reliable, compliant and lasting deliverables.

deliverables.text: Sizing, plan review and actionable structural recommendations.

deliverables.title: Site supervision
deliverables.text: On-site presence, progress checkpoints and timely quality alerts.

deliverables.title: Compliance control
deliverables.text: Standards checks, traceability and reporting for decision-makers.

deliverables.title: Owner advisory
deliverables.text: Decision support, technical arbitration and contractor framing.

deliverables.title: Clear handoff
deliverables.text: Documented summaries and deliverables for the next project phase.

approach: Understand the brief, the site and your budget constraints
Set the technical frame and quality criteria from day one
Short iterations with regular validation points
Documented close-out and recommendations for operation

Developers securing a residential or commercial project
Construction teams needing an independent technical eye
Infrastructure or rehabilitation projects to frame
